claim: Madeira lies some seven hundred kilometres off the coast of Morocco and close to a thousand from Lisbon
because: Madeira lies about 520 km west of Morocco (the nearest African coast), not about 700 km. The figure of roughly 1,000 km from Lisbon is right. The key (Madeira) is unaffected.
fix: Madeira lies some five hundred kilometres off the coast of Morocco and close to a thousand from Lisbon
